text:
Alex: quick heads up — launching paid search + retarget test for May launch tomorrow morning :rocket: need final pacing plan and creative cadence. thinking hourly smoothing to avoid big spikes.
Mei Chen: timeline? which geos and budget windows?
Alex: US/UK first tranche. total daily cap `15,000` across search + retarget. goal: keep CPL <= $45 and volume steady through day.
Samir: suggest split `70/30` search/retarget to start. retarget window 14d, freq cap 3/day. exclude converters from retarget list.
Jordan: creative plan — 3 hero headlines + 2 supporting CTAs. want to stagger hero rotate every 4 hours to reduce fatigue :thinking_face:
Priya: tracking templates ready. use this UTM base:
```
?utm_source=paid_search&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=may_launch&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative}
```
Alex: love it. for hourly smoothing, we can run an experiment: control = even hourly, variant = spline-weighted to morning peak. need ops to implement pacing rules.
Mei Chen: I can update budget pacing in manager. what's the throttling threshold? `max_hourly_pct = 0.12` ?
Samir: try `max_hourly_pct = 0.14` on day 1 then tighten if CPL spikes. also enable dynamic bid adjustments for hourly peak windows.
Jordan: creative tagging — please add `{creative}` token values: heroA_headline, heroB_headline, heroC_headline, support1, support2.
Priya: added to template and pushed a preview sheet: https://docs.example.com/sheets/may-launch-track
Alex: AdOps — can you set up two pacing profiles and label them `control_even` and `spline_morning`? we'll A/B by audience slice (50/50 traffic).
AdOps Bot: pacing profiles created: `control_even` (flat hourly), `spline_morning_v1` (peak 9–12 local). Deployed to ad account `redwood-prod-ads` :white_check_mark:
Mei Chen: I'll tag audiences and flip the 50/50 split at 05:00 PT tomorrow. also enabling conversion pixel QA now.
Samir: reminder — creative refresh cadence: if CTR drops > 20% vs baseline over 6h, push next hero variant early.
Jordan: noted. I'll prepare alt hero images sized for search assets.
Priya: landing page UTM mapping done. GA and Looker dashboards flagged for cohort. ping me if any mismatch.
Alex: perfect. summary: US/UK, daily cap `15000`, split 70/30 search/retarget, retarget 14d freq 3, pacing AB test `control_even` vs `spline_morning_v1`, creative rotate every 4h with early refresh rule. launch 05:00 PT tomorrow. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Mei Chen: on it. will post a confirmation message once split goes live.
Samir: I'll watch CPL first 3 hours and call pause if > $60
Jordan: assets uploading now.
Priya: QA check done for tracking.
Alex: thanks team — keep thread updates short (time / issue). :pray:
Mei Chen: live split initiated at 05:00 PT — both profiles running. last check: pacing looks smooth.
Samir: seeing higher spend in UK AM — adjusting bid multipliers down 8% for first 2 hours.
Alex: noted. keep monitoring, we'll regroup in 4 hours for a quick readout.
Mei Chen: quick note — one creative variant had missing tracking token, fixed.
AdOps Bot: hourly pacing anomaly detected: UK region spike 06:12 PT, auto-adjust applied (-8% bids). Incident closed.
Alex: great, thx. updates only if > material impact or pause.
